title: Wood 1996: centroid distance of psoas major at L4-L5 (M, unspecified)

imaging.plane: transverse image at the L4-L5 level (scanner axial)

quantity.name: centroid_distance
quantity.definition: distance from the vertebral-body (or disc) centroid to the muscle area centroid in the image plane; AP signed (+ anterior, - posterior), ML unsigned lateral distance. NOT a true moment arm

source.authors: Wood S, Pearsall DJ, Ross R, Reid JG
source.sample: 26 males; males with BMI 19.7-39.5 (lean to obese)

how_to_simulate: Pose the model (scan posture not stated; presumably supine).
At the L4-L5 level take the PCSA-weighted centroid of the muscle in the transverse plane.
Report AP (+ anterior) and |ML| from the vertebral/disc centroid; centroid distance, not moment arm.
protocol.notes: Authors call these moment arms (muscle centroid to vertebral centroid).

data.note: paper sign convention is + posterior (paraspinal positive, rectus negative); sign flipped to + anterior

extraction.check_notes: All values read from the rendered (rotated) Table 1 on p.142; text layer had OCR errors (e.g. BMI 25-30 mass printed 93.5 in text layer, 83.5 on the page).
